metadata.question: Was there more smoke on January 1, 2020 in the coastal regions of Victoria and New South Wales, Australia compared to July 24, 2019?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-5P Aerosol Index (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_AI) for two dates: 2019-07-24 and 2020-01-01 over the coastal band (0–50 km inland) of Victoria and New South Wales, Australia. If no images on the exact day, widen to ±1 day.
2. Masking strategy: Mask pixels with qa_value < 0.5 (quality filter). No cloud mask beyond product QA.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: Check collection size; if 0 after fallback -> C1. After masking, compute valid pixel count; if 0 -> C2. If mean is null/NaN or out-of-expected range -> C3. Try/catch any API issues -> D.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const admin = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1');
    const ausStates = admin.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Australia'));
    const vic = ausStates.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Victoria')).geometry();
    const nsw = ausStates.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'New South Wales')).geometry();
    const region = vic.union(nsw, 1);
    const coast = region.difference(region.buffer(-50000)); // 0–50 km inland coastal band

    const dates = [
      { label: '2019-07-24', start: '2019-07-24', end: '2019-07-25' },
      { label: '2020-01-01', start: '2020-01-01', end: '2020-01-02' }
    ];
    const scale = 5000;

    // Helper: build S5P AAI composite with QA mask; try fallback ±1 day if empty
    async function getCompositeStats(dateObj) {
      function qaMask(img) {
        const qa = img.select('qa_value');
        return img.updateMask(qa.gte(0.5));
      }
      function getCol(start, end) {
        return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_AI')
          .filterDate(start, end)
          .filterBounds(coast)
          .select(['absorbing_aerosol_index', 'qa_value'])
          .map(qaMask);
      }
      let col = getCol(dateObj.start, dateObj.end);
      let size = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (size === 0) {
        // fallback: widen by ±1 day
        const start2 = ee.Date(dateObj.start).advance(-1, 'day').format('YYYY-MM-dd');
        const end2 = ee.Date(dateObj.end).advance(1, 'day').format('YYYY-MM-dd');
        const start2Str = await start2.getInfo();
        const end2Str = await end2.getInfo();
        col = getCol(start2Str, end2Str);
        size = await col.size().getInfo();
        if (size === 0) {
          return { label: dateObj.label, images: 0, c1: true };
        }
      }
      const composite = col.median();
      // Verify band existence
      const bands = await composite.bandNames().getInfo();
      const bandName = bands.includes('absorbing_aerosol_index') ? 'absorbing_aerosol_index' : null;
      if (!bandName) {
        return { label: dateObj.label, images: size, d: true };
      }
      // Stats
      const validCountDict = await composite.select(bandName).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: coast,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).getInfo();
      const validCount = validCountDict ? validCountDict[bandName] : 0;
      const totalCountDict = await ee.Image(1).rename('c').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: coast,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).getInfo();
      const totalCount = totalCountDict ? totalCountDict['c'] : 0;
      if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
        return { label: dateObj.label, images: size, valid: 0, total: totalCount, c2: true };
      }
      const meanDict = await composite.select(bandName).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: coast,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).getInfo();
      const mean = meanDict ? meanDict[bandName] : null;
      const posDict = await composite.select(bandName).gt(1).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: coast,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).getInfo();
      const posCount = posDict ? posDict[bandName] : 0;
      const invalidPct = totalCount > 0 ? (1 - validCount / totalCount) * 100 : null;
      return { label: dateObj.label, images: size, mean: mean, valid: validCount, total: totalCount, pos: posCount, invalidPct: invalidPct };
    }

    const s1 = await getCompositeStats(dates[0]);
    const s2 = await getCompositeStats(dates[1]);

    // Output concise evidence (max 20 lines)
    if (s1.c1 || s2.c1) {
      console.log(`Region pixels (approx @${scale}m):`, (s1.total || s2.total || 0));
      console.log(`${dates[0].label} Images: ${s1.images || 0}`);
      console.log(`${dates[1].label} Images: ${s2.images || 0}`);
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both dates).');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    if (s1.d || s2.d) {
      console.log('D: Dataset or band access issue.');
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }
    if (s1.c2 || s2.c2) {
      console.log(`Region pixels (approx @${scale}m):`, (s1.total || s2.total || 0));
      console.log(`${dates[0].label} Images: ${s1.images || 0}`);
      console.log(`${dates[1].label} Images: ${s2.images || 0}`);
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels after QA/masking for one or both dates.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    const invalidMean = (v) => (v === null || v === undefined || isNaN(v) || Math.abs(v) > 20);
    if (invalidMean(s1.mean) || invalidMean(s2.mean)) {
      console.log('C3: Calculation failure (mean is null/NaN/invalid range).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const pctPos1 = s1.valid > 0 ? (s1.pos / s1.valid) * 100 : 0;
    const pctPos2 = s2.valid > 0 ? (s2.pos / s2.valid) * 100 : 0;
    console.log(`Region pixels (approx @${scale}m): ${s1.total}`);
    console.log(`${s1.label} Images: ${s1.images}`);
    console.log(`${s1.label} Valid px: ${s1.valid}, Mean AAI: ${s1.mean.toFixed(3)}, Pct AAI>1: ${pctPos1.toFixed(1)}%, Invalid%: ${s1.invalidPct.toFixed(1)}%`);
    console.log(`${s2.label} Images: ${s2.images}`);
    console.log(`${s2.label} Valid px: ${s2.valid}, Mean AAI: ${s2.mean.toFixed(3)}, Pct AAI>1: ${pctPos2.toFixed(1)}%, Invalid%: ${s2.invalidPct.toFixed(1)}%`);

    // Decision: More smoke if mean AAI is higher on 2020-01-01; tie-breaker by Pct AAI>1
    let answer = 'B: No';
    if (s2.mean > s1.mean + 0.05 || (Math.abs(s2.mean - s1.mean) <= 0.05 && pctPos2 > pctPos1)) {
      answer = 'A: Yes';
    }
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('D: Exception -', e.message ? e.message : e);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
